title: Intumwa yahanganye n’abasenga ibigirwamana .
intro: Mu gihe ukwihebera Imana kwari kwazimiye, intumwa yarahagurutse ihamagara abantu ngo basubire gusenga Umukama w’isi. Uwo mubare wari uhagaze ushikamye ku bantu bari bashinze imizi mu gusenga imana y’ikinyoma, bikaba bibutsa Umuremyi wabo w’ukuri be n’Umukama wa ba sekuruza babo. Yamara rero abantu ntibavyitaho, banka iyo ngabisho, bashira ikidodo ku bijanye n’iherezo ryabo bwite. None uwo muhamagazi ataco azunguruka yari nde?
clues: Narungitswe ku bantu bari barahevye inzira y’Imana imwe y’ukuri.
Nabajije abantu banje nti: «Mbega ntimuzotinya Allah?»
Nabahamagariye guheba ugusenga imana y’ikinyoma yitwa Bayali.
Abantu banje banse umuhamagaro wanje, bakomeza gusenga ibigirwamana.
Kubera ukwihakana kwabo, bazosohorwa ata gukeka kugira ngo bahanwe.
Umukama wanje yampaye amahoro n’ukwibuka guhezagiwe mu bihe vya nyuma.
